text:
Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the summer Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
Won(x, y, z) ::: x won y medals in z.
Premises:
∀x (SummerOlympicGames(x) → SportingEvent(x)) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympicGames(tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Won(unitedStates, mostMedals, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬In(lastSummerOlympicGames, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
